scientific.integrity: The proof uses exact stationary balance laws, a new stationary cross-moment identity, Cauchy–Schwarz, and a complete equality-rigidity argument. The earlier same-object result is treated as prior input, not re-claimed.
limitations: Compact support and positive parameters are required.
The result is necessary for compact recurrence and does not prove existence.
The excursion law gives positive mass beyond the unit barrier but no quantitative mass fraction.

title: Universal unit-amplitude excursion for recurrent Moore–Spiegel dynamics
